Good to know

How do I pick my size?

Sizes are UK 6 to 11. Chunky and platform pairs run roomy, so if you are between sizes, go with the smaller one.

How long does delivery take?

Orders usually arrive in 3 to 7 working days. You get a tracking link as soon as the pair ships.

Can I return a pair I have tried on?

Yes. Unworn-in-the-street pairs can be returned or exchanged within 30 days in the original box.

Which payment methods do you accept?

Cards, UPI and net banking, all through an encrypted checkout.
